mapper.select: SELECT id, event_no, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_at FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = #{retryCount} WHERE id = #{id}
